pre_findings: Scaling lens: the decisive cheap falsifier is whether every standard remainder carries a positive net power of a after inserting source A,E,D bounds.
Pressure lens: D alone supplies magnitude control only; any signed pressure cancellation must be separately sourced.
Vorticity lens: Seregin Section 4 is a same-source success analogue but depends on axisymmetry, swirl-free transport and extra derivative control absent from the general atom.
Compactness lens: a purely prelimit estimate can avoid moving-radius convergence only if it controls the unnormalized cutoff remainder needed by the Euler/global consumer.
Verifier lens: if a derived upper bound grows, the correct conclusion is 'this estimate cannot force vanishing', not 'the actual term diverges'.
Method lens: SEARCH is authorized only for exponent-audit methodology; the Section 4 conservation theorem itself is not transferred.
